انهضت (form VII)

# اِنْهَضْتَ (inhaḍta) /in.hadˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْهَاضَ (inhāḍa)
# اِنْهَضْتِ (inhaḍti) /in.hadˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْهَاضَ (inhāḍa)
